name: aegis
description: Aegis — a privacy-preserving browser vision agent (SIH26171, ISRO / Dept. of Space)

scripts.build: pnpm --filter aegis-extension build && pnpm --filter aegis-extension build:firefox
scripts.zip: pnpm --filter aegis-extension zip && pnpm --filter aegis-extension zip:firefox
scripts.server: uv run --project server uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload --app-dir server
scripts.server:lint: uv run --project server ruff check server && uv run --project server ruff format --check server
scripts.check: pnpm run schema:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test && pnpm run server:lint && pnpm run server:test
